_meta.datasheet_section: Figure 5-1 (DRV Package 6-Pin WSON Top View) + Table 5-1 (Pin Functions)
_meta.notes: Two package variants in datasheet: WSON-6 (DRV, used here) and DSBGA-6 (YBG). This pinspec is for the DRV (WSON) variant only.

pins.name: ALERT
pins.note: Over-temperature alert / data-ready signal. Open-drain — requires pullup.

pins.name: ADD0
pins.note: Address select. Connect to GND, V+, SDA, or SCL to pick I²C addr 0x48-0x4B.

pins.name: V+
pins.note: Supply voltage. Datasheet §6 Power Supply: 1.8 V to 5.5 V over -55 to +150 °C (1.7 V minimum allowed for -55 to +70 °C only). Typical 3.3 V.

pins.name: SDA
pins.note: Serial data, open-drain bidirectional. Requires pullup.

pins.name: EP
pins.note: Exposed thermal pad — connect to GND for thermal dissipation.
